ex.en: The sample is not pure enough.
ex.zh: 這個樣本不夠純。

ex.en: The doctor took a blood sample.
ex.zh: 醫生抽了血液樣本。

ex.en: Would you show us some samples of your work?
ex.zh: 可以讓我們看看你的作品樣本嗎？

ex.en: The store was giving out free samples of cheese.
ex.zh: 那家店在發送起司試吃品。

ex.en: You can sample local food at the night market.
ex.zh: 你可以在夜市品嚐當地美食。

ex.en: We sampled five kinds of tea.
ex.zh: 我們試喝了五種茶。

ex.en: Don't forget to save your work.
ex.zh: 別忘了存檔。

ex.en: Save the file before you close the program.
ex.zh: 關閉程式前先存檔。

ex.en: I am saving money in order to study abroad.
ex.zh: 我在存錢準備出國留學。

ex.en: I am working to save for my college tuition.
ex.zh: 我打工是為了存大學學費。

ex.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
ex.zh: 電腦幫我們省了很多時間和麻煩。

ex.en: The bridge saved us a lot of time.
ex.zh: 那座橋幫我們省了很多時間。

ex.en: The doctor saved her life.
ex.zh: 醫生救了她的命。

ex.en: He saved a child from drowning.
ex.zh: 他救了一個差點溺水的孩子。

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
ex.zh: 我覺得你應該吃個火腿三明治。

ex.en: What kind of sandwich do you want?
ex.zh: 你想要哪一種三明治？

ex.en: Mongolia is sandwiched between Russia and China.
ex.zh: 蒙古夾在俄羅斯和中國之間。

ex.en: My meeting is sandwiched between two calls.
ex.zh: 我的會議被夾在兩通電話之間。

ex.en: My mother forgot to add salt to the salad.
ex.zh: 我媽媽忘了在沙拉裡加鹽。

ex.en: You have the choice of soup or salad.
ex.zh: 你可以選湯或沙拉。

ex.en: Tom is in the kitchen making a salad.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在廚房做沙拉。

ex.en: The salesperson showed us several models.
ex.zh: 店員給我們看了好幾種型號。

ex.en: She is the top salesperson in our company.
ex.zh: 她是我們公司業績最好的業務員。

ex.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.
ex.zh: 船被安全地引導進港。

ex.en: When you safely arrive at your destination, don't forget to call me.
ex.zh: 你平安抵達目的地後，別忘了打電話給我。

ex.en: The fishing boat which had been missing returned safely to port.
ex.zh: 失蹤的漁船平安回港了。

ex.en: It may safely be said that he will never succeed in business.
ex.zh: 可以肯定地說，他做生意永遠不會成功。

ex.en: I can safely say this is the best hotel in town.
ex.zh: 我可以肯定地說，這是城裡最好的飯店。

satisfactory.zh: 令人滿意的、符合要求的

ex.en: The results of the research were quite satisfactory.
ex.zh: 研究結果相當令人滿意。

ex.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
ex.zh: 這個解釋一點都不令人滿意。

ex.en: His work performance is satisfactory.
ex.zh: 他的工作表現令人滿意。

ex.en: He makes a living as a salesman.
ex.zh: 他以當推銷員維生。

ex.en: I was mistaken for a salesman.
ex.zh: 我被誤認為是推銷員。

ex.en: The customer and the salesman spoke for two hours on the phone.
ex.zh: 顧客和業務員講了兩個小時的電話。

ex.en: She likes to go to the sauna.
ex.zh: 她喜歡去洗三溫暖。

ex.en: The hotel has a gym and a sauna.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有健身房和三溫暖。

salespeople.zh: 銷售人員、業務員、店員（salesperson 的複數）

ex.en: Our salespeople visit clients every week.
ex.zh: 我們的業務員每週拜訪客戶。

ex.en: The salespeople in that store were very helpful.
ex.zh: 那家店的店員很熱心。

ex.en: I have an appointment at the hair salon on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我星期六在髮廊有預約。

ex.en: She opened a beauty salon downtown.
ex.zh: 她在市中心開了一家美容院。

ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
ex.zh: 讓衛星繞著地球運轉的是重力。

ex.en: A satellite was launched in Russia last year.
ex.zh: 俄羅斯去年發射了一顆衛星。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選一張合適的衛星影像當作底圖。

ex.en: He carried a sack of rice on his back.
ex.zh: 他背著一袋米。

ex.en: We bought two sacks of potatoes.
ex.zh: 我們買了兩大袋馬鈴薯。

ex.en: My father has been sacked.
ex.zh: 我爸爸被開除了。

ex.en: I was sacked yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天被開除了。

sack.zh: hit the sack：上床睡覺（口語）

ex.en: I need to hit the sack.
ex.zh: 我該去睡了。

ex.en: It's time to hit the sack.
ex.zh: 該睡覺了。

ex.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
ex.zh: 犧牲一個人去救很多人，這樣合乎道德嗎？

ex.en: She sacrificed her weekends to finish the project.
ex.zh: 她犧牲週末來完成這個專案。

ex.en: Parents make many sacrifices for their children.
ex.zh: 父母為孩子做出許多犧牲。

ex.en: Working abroad was a big sacrifice for my family.
ex.zh: 到國外工作對我們家來說是很大的犧牲。

ex.en: We need safeguards against data loss.
ex.zh: 我們需要防止資料遺失的保護措施。

ex.en: The new law includes safeguards for workers.
ex.zh: 新法律包含保障勞工的措施。

ex.en: We must safeguard our customers' data.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護客戶的資料。

ex.en: The policy is designed to safeguard employees' rights.
ex.zh: 這項政策是為了維護員工的權益。

ex.en: We managed to salvage the deal at the last minute.
ex.zh: 我們在最後一刻挽救了這筆交易。

ex.en: Can you salvage any files from the broken laptop?
ex.zh: 你能從壞掉的筆電救回任何檔案嗎？

ex.en: The salvage operation took three weeks.
ex.zh: 打撈作業花了三個星期。

ex.en: Salvage crews recovered the ship's cargo.
ex.zh: 打撈人員找回了船上的貨物。

sadly.zh: 遺憾的是、可惜（常放句首）

ex.en: Sadly, I have to wake up early every day.
ex.zh: 可惜的是，我每天都得早起。

ex.en: Sadly, most young people speak dialect only rarely.
ex.zh: 遺憾的是，大多數年輕人已經很少說方言了。

ex.en: The doctors did all they could to control Tom's disease but, sadly, to no avail.
ex.zh: 醫生們盡力控制湯姆的病情，但可惜還是沒有用。

ex.en: "He used to love me," she answered sadly.
ex.zh: 「他以前很愛我。」她傷心地回答。

ex.en: Tom looked sadly at the empty house.
ex.zh: 湯姆悲傷地看著那間空房子。

ex.en: Savers are earning very little interest these days.
ex.zh: 最近存款人賺到的利息很少。

ex.en: I'm a good saver; I put money aside every month.
ex.zh: 我很會存錢，每個月都會存一筆。

ex.en: This dishwasher is a real time saver.
ex.zh: 這台洗碗機真的很省時間。

ex.en: The app is a money saver for travelers.
ex.zh: 這個 App 能幫旅客省錢。

ex.en: Whatever I do, she says I can do better.
ex.zh: 不管我做什麼，她都說我可以做得更好。

ex.en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
ex.zh: 你跟他說的話讓他好受多了。

ex.en: The sign says "No parking."
ex.zh: 告示上寫著「禁止停車」。

ex.en: What does the email say?
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件寫了什麼？

ex.en: Let's meet at, say, three o'clock?
ex.zh: 我們約，比方說三點，好嗎？

ex.en: Say you lost your job. What would you do?
ex.zh: 假設你失業了，你會怎麼做？

ex.en: Employees should have a say in the decision.
ex.zh: 員工應該對這個決定有發言權。

ex.en: I had no say in the matter.
ex.zh: 這件事我沒有決定權。

say.zh: it goes without saying：不用說、理所當然

ex.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
ex.zh: 不用說，錢買不到幸福。

ex.en: It goes without saying that safety comes first.
ex.zh: 不用說，安全第一。

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一再犯同樣的錯誤。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這就是我昨天弄丟的那支筆。

ex.en: I want the same jacket as you are wearing.
ex.zh: 我想要一件跟你身上那件一樣的外套。

ex.en: If I were you, I would do the same.
ex.zh: 如果我是你，我也會這麼做。

ex.en: I'll have the same, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一樣的。

ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
ex.zh: 你應該把貴重物品放在安全的地方。

ex.en: I suggest we move to a safer location.
ex.zh: 我建議我們換到更安全的地方。

ex.en: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.
ex.zh: 她一戴上安全帽，就覺得安全多了。

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: Please keep your passport in the hotel safe.
ex.zh: 請把護照放在飯店的保險箱裡。

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 整體來說，我對這個結果很滿意。

ex.en: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我們無法滿足您的要求。

ex.en: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.
ex.zh: 要讓每個人都滿意很難。

ex.en: The product must satisfy all safety standards.
ex.zh: 這項產品必須符合所有安全標準。

ex.en: Applicants must satisfy the following requirements.
ex.zh: 申請人必須符合下列條件。

ex.en: When she was reading the letter, she looked sad.
ex.zh: 她讀信時看起來很難過。

ex.en: She got really sad because of what he said.
ex.zh: 她因為他說的話而非常傷心。

ex.en: One night he came home very tired and sad.
ex.zh: 有天晚上他回到家，又累又難過。

ex.en: It's sad that the old bookstore is closing.
ex.zh: 那家老書店要關門了，真令人遺憾。

ex.en: The sad truth is that we can't afford it.
ex.zh: 令人遺憾的事實是我們負擔不起。

ex.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
ex.zh: 哥倫布往更遠的西方航行，尋找新大陸。

ex.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
ex.zh: 他們沿著非洲西岸航行。

ex.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在教我怎麼駕駛帆船。

ex.en: The boat has a large white sail.
ex.zh: 那艘船有一面很大的白帆。

ex.en: The sailors raised the sails at dawn.
ex.zh: 水手們在黎明時升起了帆。

ex.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
ex.zh: 湯姆彎下腰，抓起一把沙子。

ex.en: We found the footprints in the sand.
ex.zh: 我們在沙灘上發現了腳印。

ex.en: Kids are building sand castles on the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在海灘上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Sand the wood before you paint it.
ex.zh: 上漆前先把木頭用砂紙磨過。

ex.en: He sanded the table until it was smooth.
ex.zh: 他把桌子磨到很光滑。

ex.en: My mother forgot to add salt to the salad.
ex.zh: 我媽媽忘了在沙拉裡加鹽。

ex.en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
ex.zh: 她發現鹽用完了。

ex.en: Mary puts salt on just about everything she eats.
ex.zh: 瑪莉幾乎吃什麼都要加鹽。

ex.en: Tom salted his egg.
ex.zh: 湯姆在蛋上撒了鹽。

ex.en: Salt the water before adding the pasta.
ex.zh: 放義大利麵之前先在水裡加鹽。

salt.zh: take … with a grain of salt：對…半信半疑

ex.en: Take his advice with a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 他的建議聽聽就好。

ex.en: I take online reviews with a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 我對網路評論持保留態度。

sake.zh: for the sake of：為了……（的緣故）

ex.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
ex.zh: 為了健康，我戒菸了。

ex.en: They fought for the sake of their country.
ex.zh: 他們為了國家而戰。

ex.en: Let's stay calm for the sake of the children.
ex.zh: 為了孩子，我們冷靜一點吧。

ex.en: My father doesn't drink so much sake.
ex.zh: 我爸爸不太喝清酒。

ex.en: We ordered a bottle of sake with our sushi.
ex.zh: 我們點了一瓶清酒配壽司。

ex.en: The sailors loaded the cargo onto the ship.
ex.zh: 船員們把貨物裝上船。

ex.en: My uncle worked as a sailor for twenty years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔當了二十年的船員。

ex.en: Please adjust the bike saddle to your height.
ex.zh: 請依你的身高調整腳踏車座墊。

ex.en: He put the saddle on the horse.
ex.zh: 他把馬鞍放到馬背上。

ex.en: She saddled him with the work.
ex.zh: 她把這份工作硬塞給他。

ex.en: The company is saddled with huge debts.
ex.zh: 這家公司背負著龐大的債務。

ex.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
ex.zh: 這次特賣從今天開始，為期三天。

ex.en: I might check for sales or discounts online.
ex.zh: 我可能會上網看看有沒有特價或折扣。

ex.en: The sale prices are written in red ink.
ex.zh: 特價的價格是用紅字寫的。

ex.en: Sales fell off in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季的銷售額下滑了。

ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
ex.zh: 誰負責業務部門？

ex.en: Is this car for sale?
ex.zh: 這輛車要賣嗎？

ex.en: Their house is for sale.
ex.zh: 他們的房子要出售。

ex.en: You can't drink seawater because it is too salty.
ex.zh: 你不能喝海水，因為它太鹹了。

ex.en: This soup is too salty to eat.
ex.zh: 這碗湯太鹹了，喝不下去。

ex.en: This food is too salty.
ex.zh: 這個食物太鹹了。

ex.en: Do you prefer sweet or savory snacks?
ex.zh: 你喜歡甜的還是鹹的點心？

ex.en: The savory pancake was filled with cheese and ham.
ex.zh: 這個鹹煎餅裡夾了起司和火腿。

ex.en: After months of stress, he began to fear for his sanity.
ex.zh: 經過數個月的壓力，他開始擔心自己的精神狀態。

ex.en: Take a break to keep your sanity.
ex.zh: 休息一下，才能保持你的理智。

ex.en: Tom is quite sarcastic.
ex.zh: 湯姆真會挖苦人。

ex.en: Don't you think the name "The Sacred War" sounds a bit sarcastic?
ex.zh: 你不覺得這個名字很諷刺嗎，「神聖的戰爭」？

ex.en: He saluted the lady.
ex.zh: 他向那位女士致意。

ex.en: The soldiers saluted the flag during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 典禮中士兵們向國旗敬禮。

ex.en: The problem between the two neighbors was settled satisfactorily.
ex.zh: 兩家鄰居之間的問題圓滿解決了。

ex.en: She answered all the interviewer's questions satisfactorily.
ex.zh: 她令人滿意地回答了面試官所有的問題。

ex.en: "God is our salvation," said the priest.
ex.zh: 「天主是我們的救贖。」神父說。

ex.en: For the lonely old man, his dog was his salvation.
ex.zh: 對那位孤單的老人來說，他的狗就是他的救星。

ex.en: Many people turn to religion in search of salvation.
ex.zh: 許多人為了尋求救贖而轉向宗教。

ex.en: Many countries imposed sanctions on the regime.
ex.zh: 許多國家對該政權實施制裁。

ex.en: The sanctions hurt the country's economy.
ex.zh: 這些制裁重創了該國經濟。

ex.en: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
ex.zh: 要進入這棟建築，必須得到主管機關的批准。

ex.en: The plan has the sanction of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得了董事會的認可。

ex.en: You should put safety before everything else.
ex.zh: 你應該把安全放在其他一切之上。

ex.en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
ex.zh: 公車司機要負責乘客的安全。

ex.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
ex.zh: 如果不遵守安全程序，你可能會受傷。

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 總的來說，我對這個結果很滿意。

ex.en: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
ex.zh: 我對這個結果一點兒也不滿意。

ex.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.
ex.zh: 他對自己的勞動成果很滿意。

ex.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
ex.zh: 我想開一個儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: I put part of my salary into a savings account every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月把部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
ex.zh: 不管讀書的主要目的是什麼，書總能帶給人滿足。

ex.en: I won't give them the satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我不會讓他們稱心如意的。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意是我們的首要目標。

ex.en: Use a formal salutation in the first email.
ex.zh: 第一封電子郵件請使用正式稱呼。

ex.en: The letter begins with the salutation Dear Ms. Chen.
ex.zh: 這封信以「陳小姐您好」作為稱呼。

sabbatical.zh: （通常為進修或研究而安排的）長期休假

ex.en: After ten years with the firm, Mei took a sabbatical to complete her research.
ex.zh: 在公司任職十年後，美玲休了長假完成研究。

ex.en: The university offers faculty a sabbatical for study or research.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供教職員進修或研究假。

ex.en: With most households already subscribed, the streaming market is nearing saturation.
ex.zh: 由於多數家庭都已訂閱，串流市場正接近飽和。

ex.en: The study measures market saturation before the company opens another branch.
ex.zh: 公司再開一家分店前，先透過研究評估市場飽和程度。

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他薪水太低，買不起房子。

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他的高薪讓他生活過得很舒適。

ex.en: I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
ex.zh: 我一領到薪水就還你錢。
